serverInfo.name: html-css-to-image-mcp
serverInfo.title: HTML/CSS to Image MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for HTML/CSS to Image, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Render this HTML card as a 1200x630 PNG and give me the URL."; "Take a screenshot of https://example.com at 2x scale as a JPG."; "How many images have I rendered this month, and what is my limit?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HTML/CSS to Image data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run htmlcss_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run htmlcss_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run htmlcss_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. htmlcss_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: htmlcss_check_usage
tools.title: Check image usage
tools.description: Show image credits rendered per hour, day and month, and per billing period. Read only. Needs the usage:read permission. HCTI API: GET /v1/usage.

tools.name: htmlcss_list_images
tools.title: List rendered images
tools.description: List images this account rendered, newest first, 50 per page at most. Use next_page_token for the next page. Needs images:read. HCTI API: GET /v1/images.

tools.name: htmlcss_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the saved templates in this account. Use an id from the result with htmlcss_get_template or htmlcss_create_templated_image. Needs templates:read. HCTI API: GET /v1/template.

tools.name: htmlcss_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one saved template by id, with its HTML, CSS, variables and render options. Needs templates:read. HCTI API: GET /v1/template/{template_id}.

template_id.description: The template id, for example from htmlcss_list_templates.

tools.name: htmlcss_create_image
tools.title: Render an image from HTML or a URL
tools.description: Render HTML/CSS (or a public URL screenshot) to a hosted image and return its URL. Give exactly one of html or url. Each call uses image credits. Needs images:create. HCTI API: POST /v1/image.

html.description: HTML to render: a snippet or a full page. Use this or url, not both.

css.description: CSS for the HTML (injected into the page when url is used).

url.description: Public web page to screenshot. Use this or html, not both.

device_scale.description: Pixel ratio, 0.1 to 3 (higher is sharper and larger).

viewport_width.description: Browser width in pixels. Set with viewport_height.

viewport_height.description: Browser height in pixels. Set with viewport_width.

ms_delay.description: Wait before capture in ms (start with 500 for JavaScript).

selector.description: CSS selector: crop the image to that element.

full_screen.description: For url: capture the full page height.

google_fonts.description: Google fonts to load, for example 'Roboto|Open Sans'.

block_consent_banners.description: For url: block cookie banners and popups.

annotations.title: Render an image from HTML or a URL

tools.name: htmlcss_create_templated_image
tools.title: Render an image from a template
tools.description: Render a saved template with values for its variables and return the image URL. Pass template_version to pin a version. Each call uses image credits. Needs images:create. HCTI API: POST /v1/image/{template_id}.

template_version.description: Pin a template version (default: the latest).

template_values.description: Values for the template variables, as a JSON object.

annotations.title: Render an image from a template
